_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Software Level of Rigor Safety Report (SLORSR)
summary: Provides a comprehensive accounting of all Level of Rigor (LOR) related work per MIL-STD-882E(C1) paragraph 4.4.
use_relationship:
The Software Level of Rigor Safety Report (SLORSR) is a comprehensive accounting of all Level of Rigor (LOR) related work per MIL-STD-882E(C1) paragraph 4.4.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the content and format preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

a. This DID is related to DI-SAFT-80102, Safety Assessment Report (SAR); and DI-SAFT-80105 System Safety Program Progress Report (SSPPR).

(Copies of these DIDs are available online at https://quicksearch.dla.mil.)
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The SLORSR shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The SLORSR shall include the following information:

children.title: Introduction
children.content: State, in narrative form, the purpose of the SLORSR.

children.title: Overview
children.content: A brief overview of the software architecture and its roles within the system.

children.title: The program's definition of what a Unit of Software is
children.content: (e.g. Computer Software Configuration Item (CSCI), Computer Software Component (CSC), Computer Software Unit (CSU); this definition is to be used in all documentation required by this DID).

children.title: Information needed to properly characterize how software is partitioned into the units of software as documented within the SLORSR.
SwCI/LOR Determination
children.content: The rationale supporting how the Software Criticality Index (SwCI)/LOR was derived for each Unit of Software.

children.title: For each unit of software, list the Software Control Category (SCC)
children.content: per MIL-STD-882E(C1) Table IV with the accompanying supporting rationale applicable to the SCC.

children.title: For each unit of software, the rationale behind determining the worst potential Severity
children.content: per MIL-STD-882E(C1) Table I for the unit of software. Several hazards may involve the same unit of software, the most severe Severity; the most severe Severity is used.

children.title: For each unit of software, list the derived Software Criticality Index (SwCI)
children.content: per MIL-STD-882E(C1) Table V and the accompanying tier of Level of Rigor (LOR).

children.title: LOR Activities
Describe each LOR Activity for each LOR Tier
Provide LOR artifacts correlated to each LOR activity for each Unit of Software.
LOR Activity Status
Define the timeline when MIL-STD-882E(C1) Table VI will be queried.
children.content: Typical program timelines may include prior to Preliminary Design Review (PDR), prior to Critical Design Review (CDR), prior to formal testing, prior to fielding, and periodically during sustainment.

children.title: For each unit of software, provide status of MIL-STD-882E(C1) Table VI questions for each LOR activity.
For each LOR Tier's Activity:
Annotate what is left to be defined.
Annotate Government Management (PM) decision to expend additional resources to define LOR activity or to obtain Risk Acceptance Authority's formal acceptance for the unspecified LOR Tier (if any).
children.content: If unavailable, highlight the need for a decision to be made.

children.title: Summarize applicable LOR task activities.
For each unit of software for each LOR task activity, provide or cite the reference to all program artifacts required to show compliance with the LOR task activity.
Annotate specifically what is incomplete with the LOR criteria.
Annotate Government PM decision to expend additional resources to define the LOR activity or obtain Risk Acceptance Authority's formal acceptance for the incomplete LOR activity.
children.content: If unavailable, highlight the need for a decision to be made.
